title: Reversal of Pre-K Tuition Late Fees on Eligibility-Credited Months
content:
## Rule

On a Pre-K tuition account of Student Enrollment, Transfers and Pre-Kindergarten Admissions, when the most recent billing month's tuition charge carries an eligibility credit, the late fee posted for that billing month is reversed in whole or in part by a credit against the late fee with the credit reason "eligibility established". The reversal lowers the amount the household owes on the enrollment, and the family sees it next to that late fee on the statement.

The late-fee reversal is not fixed until the eligibility credit owed on the month's tuition has been worked out and posted.

## Posting the reversal: `credit_prek_late_fee_reversal_2a81de73`

**Capability.** The tool books one credit entry, dated today, marked as an eligibility-established credit, against one named late fee entry of a Pre-K tuition account.

**How it is invoked.** This is an agent-side tool: the support agent unlocks `credit_prek_late_fee_reversal_2a81de73` and then calls it.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | What it is | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `enrollment_ledger_id` | the identifier of the late fee entry being reversed, as returned by the tuition ledger lookup for the enrollment | text id |
| `amount` | the reversal to book | US dollars, a positive number with 2 decimal places; the tool rounds half up to the cent before booking |

**Return.** On success, a one-line receipt beginning "Late fee reversal posted:" gives the new credit entry reference, the late fee reference it offsets, the enrollment reference, the amount booked (USD, two decimals) and the posting date (YYYY-MM-DD). A receipt beginning "Error:" means nothing was booked: the late fee reference was not found, or the amount was not a positive USD amount.

## Contract points

- The entry named in `enrollment_ledger_id` is the late fee itself, not the month's tuition charge.
- The tool books what it is given; it does not work out the amount.
